definitions.auto: weave_mega_moe() with ZERO WEAVE_* env: calibrated profile bucket (log2-nearest S_global) + runtime rules
definitions.default: weave_mega_moe() with WEAVE_AUTOTUNE=0: compiled defaults, nothing injected
definitions.oracle: fastest of the fixed hand-tuned arms (winners of earlier public-knob sweeps, SM fractions scaled by num_sms)
definitions.official: official DeepGEMM MegaMoE (H20: in-process WEAVE_FORCE_OFFICIAL=1 path; B300: separate upstream checkout)
definitions.ratios: x_over_y = median_us(x) / median_us(y); < 1 means x is faster
definitions.auto_tflops_per_card: S_global*K*6*H*I / EP / t_auto (dense-equivalent routed-expert FLOPs, one card)
